answer: No, your offer hasn't necessarily expired: offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, so the 5-day limit doesn't apply to your January 28 offer. We honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date. Seven days from January 28 would be around February 4, so check the exact expiration date on your offer page or confirmation email before you book. Also keep your mileage under 300 additional miles, and if the offer does expire, you can request a new one at current market prices.
